name: RamblePaws : Songkhla's Meowventure
source:
Destiny has bought "Cat" to "Manoch", a tanned young man and began a journey in Songkhla for two of them. What would they encounter in this journey?

[Translated from [url=https://bugmanwo.itch.io/ramblepaws-songkhlas-meowventure]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
命运把“猫”买给了晒黑的年轻人“马诺克”，并为他们两个人开始了宋卡之旅。他们在这趟旅程中会遇到什么？

[译自[url=https://bugmanwo.itch.io/ramblepaws-songkhlas-meowventure]Itch.io[/url]]
